note: Historic Uravan ballpark on CO 141 in a bend of the San Miguel River, owned by Montrose County and leased to the Rimrocker Historical Society, which runs it as a memorial picnic and camping area (the Uravan Reunion Picnic is held here each August). Shade pavilion, camp host. --Claude
summary: Rimrocker Historical Society pages (ballpark, Uravan, contact): confirmed operating for 2026 (open Apr 1 - Nov 1), electric sites reservable by phone for a $50 nonrefundable fee, phone 970-864-7438 = the society's office; added season and booking note. Pages say nothing on site count, amperage, toilets or a nightly rate; 'free, donations welcome' is not on the operator's pages. Note cleaned of field facts.

Phone 970-864-7438 confirmed: the Rimrocker Historical Society's office line (contact page '(970)864-7438', cell '(970)428-1974'), the reservation number on the ballpark page.

Inclusion: the operator's page is current for 2026 ('will open April 1st for the 2026 camping season'; Uravan page announces the 'Uravan Reunion Picnic ... August 29th, 2026'). No site count, site lengths or RV wording on the operator's pages; the 'dozen-plus sites', '4 electric-only' and portable toilets in inclusion_evidence are not on them. On NAIP the camping area is an open former ballfield (~150 x 120 m) with dirt loops and no tight spurs, so a 23-ft rig fits physically, but no source states a length. Amperage of the electric sites unknown; left hookups unset.
Ownership 'local' stands: 'DOW released the Uravan Ballpark to Montrose County. The County in turn leased the ballpark to the Rimrockers for 50 years.'
Pin 38.35776,-108.71470 is in the middle of the ballfield. OK.

Waterfront 'riverview': on NAIP the field sits inside a bend of the San Miguel River (~20-30 m wide, river-sized); picnic/camp tables and shelters line the river side, ~10-25 m from the water with open stretches of bank on the west. Possibly riverfront, but no operator source places the camp sites, so not upgraded. A human with a site map or photos could decide.
